# Dilshan Ansari (dilshanking7) — who he is

Dilshan Ansari (born 14 November 2008, Ranchi, Jharkhand, India) is an 18-year-old
full-stack web developer and AI automation engineer from Khalari, Dhanbad,
Jharkhand, India. He is a Class 10 student at Janta +2 High School, Khalari
(JAC board), and builds websites, web apps and AI automation agents.

"website banane wale Dhanbad", "web developer Khalari".

Skills: Python, Django, JavaScript, Node.js, HTML, CSS, MongoDB, Google Sheets API,
REST APIs, WebRTC, databases, backend, frontend, deployment (Render, Vercel,
GitHub Pages, Netlify), AI automation agents, Instagram automation, voice assistants.

Live projects: Smart Janta (school portal), JustYou (WebRTC video chat),
Deen-e-Islam, IndiaSite, an Instagram automation agent, a Hinglish voice assistant.
